## About
Park Place BodyWerks Plano is the Collin County collision center from the Park Place family, with sister shops in Dallas and Fort Worth. We work on all kinds of vehicles, from coupes and convertibles to work trucks and SUVs, and we specialize in the body care and collision repair of top luxury brands.
Our team is I-CAR Gold Class Certified, and the shop is factory certified by Lexus, Acura, Lincoln and Honda. We handle everything from fender benders and dings to hail damage, windshields and bent wheels, and we work with your insurance company along the way.
Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 595 Google reviews, and many of them mention being kept in the loop from check-in to pickup. That is how we like to do it.

## Services
- Collision repair: Major and minor collision repair, from a fender bender to a serious accident.
- Hail damage repair: We use specialty equipment for paintless dent and hail damage repair on all types of vehicles.
- Paintless dent repair: Dings and dents worked out without repainting, when the damage allows.
- Glass and windshield repair: Glass and windshield repair when a crack or chip shows up.
- Peeling and chipped paint: Help for paint that has started to peel or chip.
- Full vehicle detailing: A full detail to finish the job and freshen up your car.

## FAQ
Q: Which insurance companies do you work with?
A: We work with all major insurance companies, including State Farm, Allstate, AAA, Geico and USAA. To find out if we are a preferred shop for your insurer, call us or check with your insurance provider.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Contact us for a free estimate, or use the online photo estimator to get a quote without coming in.

Q: What if I need help after hours?
A: For assistance after hours, contact Jordan Towing at (972) 380-6300.

Q: What parts do you use?
A: We repair your vehicle using 100% original manufacturer parts.
